subject: reasoning
question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. B, C, D and E sit in the same row facing South. H, I, J and K sit in the same row facing North. C sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite I. H sits to the immediate left of I. K sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite D. B sits between D and E. Who sits exactly opposite H?
